items.headline: Davis rushes for 126 yards and TD, helps Liberty clinch spot in CUSA title game after 28-23 win
items.description: — Kam Davis rushed for 126 yards and a touchdown and Liberty edged Middle Tennessee 28-23 on Saturday to win its ninth straight and clinch a spot in the Conference USA football championship game on Dec. 4.
